mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT d.doc_no FROM wms_stock_doc d JOIN wms_stock_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id WHERE i.material_id = #{materialId} AND d.status IN ('TRANSIT', 'APPROVING') ORDER BY d.doc_no
SELECT DISTINCT c.doc_no FROM wms_check c JOIN wms_check_item i ON i.check_id = c.id WHERE i.material_id = #{materialId} AND c.status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVING') ORDER BY c.doc_no
